say: A knife in the dark! Okran sees it, heretic, and so will the paladins.
You come at me from behind? The Flame keeps a place for cowards like you.
Sent by the heretics, were you? You won't walk back to tell them it failed.
Okran guards his own. You should have prayed before you tried that.
Murder in the street! Seize the heretic!
You failed. Okran preserve me, and may he be slow with you.
Murder! Someone tried to murder me!
Aah! Heretic! Help, somebody, help me!
He tried to kill me! Paladins!
Not me, not me, I have done nothing! Okran, save me!
Guards! There's a killer among the faithful!
I'm a good believer! Why would anyone...
A blade at my back. A Shek does not forgive that, /FLATSKIN/.
You fight like a thief. You'll die like one.
Kral watches. He doesn't like knives in the dark.
The Stone Golem would spit on what you just did. I'll do the same, after I take your hand.
Assassin. I did not think flatskins had the nerve.
You missed. A Shek won't.
No honour in that strike, and none in your death either.
Attempted murder, in front of witnesses. That will cost you in cats and in blood.
Assassin! Someone call the guard. Someone call anyone.
A paid hand, was it? I pay better. Dead men don't collect, though.
You'll hang for this, or I'll do it myself, whichever comes first.
I have a contract, a lawyer and a sword. You're about to meet the sword.
Someone put a price on me. Funny, I'd have bid higher.
Stand where you are! The law takes a dim view of knives.
Murder! They tried to murder me!
I only sell boots! Why would anyone...
I have a family! I have debts! I am not worth killing!
Is there no law here? Someone, please!
He tried to cut me! Is no one going to do something?
I knew I should have hired a bodyguard.
Killer! Come at me from behind, would you? I've buried better than you.
Farmers hit back, friend. You should have asked around.
One of the lord's pets? Try again. It will go the same way.
I've fought for this land. I won't be put down like livestock.
Sneaking up on a farmer. Is that all the Empire has left?
You missed. Now we see if you can run.
Help! Someone help, they're trying to kill me!
I only grow barley! Why me?
Neighbours! Neighbours, there's a killer!
They came for me! Somebody sent them! Help!
Run, everyone run! A killer, a killer!
Stay away! I have nothing worth killing for!
Aaah! Help! Please, someone!
Killer! Run! Run!
Not me! I've never hurt anyone!
They tried to kill me! Does nobody see?
Get the guards! Get anyone!
Whoever paid you wasted their cats.
Quiet steps, loud mistake.
I have cut chains for years.
You missed. We seldom do.
Did the slavers pay for this? Money wasted. You won't be collecting.
From behind. A slaver's trick. You have chosen your side.
A contract on me? Flattering. Fatal for you.
Ruins try to kill me every week. You're the worse trained.
You went for the back. Bad move. I have better gear and I know what it does.
Who is paying for this? Never mind. I will ask your pockets.
I have crawled through places that wanted me dead.
/OI/! You picked the wrong /BASTARD/ to stab!
Backstabbing is MY job, you /INSULT/!
You missed. Your mistake. Your last mistake.
Right, now I'm angry. You want to die here, or further out in the dust?
Hungry, wounded and now stabbed at. Fine.
Someone paid you? Someone's gonna be short one good killer.
Cutting up a trader? That will cost you your freedom.
A knife for a slaver. Whoever hired you knows our trade. We know theirs.
Chains for him! Alive, if he runs. The price drops if he dies.
Assassin! Get the shackles!
I have sold better men than you for less. Now I'll sell you out of spite.
Ha! Meat jump from behind. Brave meat. Brave is tough. Tough is slow in pot.
You try kill me? /CANNIBALCURSE/! I eat you for dhat.
Sneaky meat. Sneaky meat should stay hide. Now it cooked.
Quiet knife. Loud scream, soon. You see.
Ungry, you? Me ungrier.
/OI/! Come up behind a Hound, will ya? Yer dog meat now.
Wrong swamp, wrong night, wrong /BASTARD/.
Ya cut me? Ya cut ME? Right.
Someone from the mud paid ya? Tell 'em the Hounds bite back.
Missed me. I'll not miss you.
Quiet one, aren't ya. Won't be quiet long.
Put them down! A kidnapper in Okran's land!
You carry one of ours. The paladins will have your legs for that.
Drop them, heretic, or you'll meet Okran sooner than you meant.
Thief of the faithful! You won't take them past me.
Okran sees you with them on your shoulder. Put them down. He's patient. I'm not.
They're taking them! Kidnapper! Guards!
Paladins! He has one of us!
Put them down! Okran have mercy, put them down!
Someone stop him! He's carrying them off!
Where are the guards? Where are the guards?
That's one of ours on your back. Put them down or we put you down.
You don't take our people. Not for the nobles, not for anyone.
Set them down, friend. Gently. I like my neighbours in one piece.
Slavers? Hunters? Whatever you are, drop them.
We have fought lords over less.
He has taken one of ours!
Put them down! Please! They have done nothing!
Kidnapper! Get the others! Get everyone!
That's my neighbour! Let go!
Run, run and tell the farms!
Stop! That's my friend! Put them down!
He's carrying them off! Someone, anyone!
No, no, no! Not them! Please!
Kidnapper! Run! Get help!
Let them go! Please, let them go!
You're carrying one of ours. That's how slavers begin.
Chains or no chains, you're taking a person.
One of ours. On your shoulder. Choose carefully what you do next.
Put them down. I won't ask again, and I ask quietly.
I cut shackles for a living. You're about to feel why.
That one is mine to watch. Put them down and we forget this.
You're carrying a friend of mine.
Whatever you're being paid for that, it isn't enough.
Drop them. My patience is the only cheap thing I carry.
Taking one of ours is a bad contract. Drop it.
/OI/! That's one of ours yer carryin'! Put 'em down!
Yer takin' a Hound's mate? Yer a dead man walkin'.
Down, down, put 'em down, or I'll put YOU down!
That's the swamp's own on yer back, /BASTARD/.
Nobody carries off our lot. Nobody.
Dhat one ours, not yours. Put down. Put down or we cook you instead.
You carry my meat. No. My friend. Same dhing.
/CANNIBALHA/! Thief of pot! Give back!
You take what ours? We take what yours.
Put down. Put down slow. Ungry hands close.
Hands off that gear. It belongs to the soldiers of the Holy Nation, outlander.
You have no business at the practice posts.
Training is for the faithful. Leave it be, or I'll test it on you.
That isn't a toy, outlander.
Okran frowns on idle hands. I frown harder.
Step away from our practice gear, /FLATSKIN/, before I show you how it's used.
That's for Shek. You would only hurt yourself, and we would laugh.
Keep your hands off it. A warrior earns the right to swing.
Flatskins at the practice post. Next they'll want our swords.
Touch it again. I invite you.
That equipment belongs to the company. Use it and you buy it.
Move away from the gear. It is not for public use.
This is a place of work. Take your tinkering elsewhere.
Hands off. If it breaks, it comes out of your pocket.
Private property, stranger. The law is generous about it.
Get yer paws off me gear!
/OI/! That's mine! I trained on that!
Touch that again and you're the new dummy.
Nobody swings on that but us.
You think we leave nice things out for strangers?
Training gear is for those who earned it.
You don't train here. Move along.
Hands off. Strangers who play with our tools get hurt.
A dummy isn't a test.
We practise for a reason. Don't ask which.
That rig took me a month to scavenge. Get your hands off it.
Don't touch what you don't understand.
Practice gear isn't for sale, and not for borrowing.
Step away. If it breaks I'm not scavenging another.
You want to learn something? Pay for it.
/OI/! Practice dummy's mine! Yer hands off!
Get away from there before I use ya for it instead.
That's Hound gear. Not yers.
Who said ya could? Nobody. That's who.
Stay off me stuff, /BASTARD/.
That's for guards. Customers keep their hands to themselves.
Step away from the gear. Property of the house.
Practice is for the ones who do the work.
Don't touch what I didn't sell you.
Hands off, or we find a use for yours.
Thief! A Shek's belongings aren't yours, /FLATSKIN/.
You steal from a warrior? Your hands will go first.
Petty theft. Beneath contempt, and still worth a beating.
Kral sees thieves, /FLATSKIN/. So do I.
A coward and a thief. Quite the pair.
Hey! That took a month of sweat to make.
Thief! We have little enough already!
You steal from farmers? That's low even for outlanders.
Put that down or I'll put the pitchfork somewhere you won't like.
Hands out of my things. Now.
You steal from those who free slaves? Put it back.
Thief. I cut chains. I can cut other things.
That isn't yours. Set it down and keep walking.
We have little. Don't take it.
Sticky fingers. I'll fix that.
Hands off. That's salvage I bled for.
You steal from a Tech Hunter? Brave, or stupid.
Put it back. I won't ask a second time.
I know exactly what's in that crate.
That's mine. Mine, and you know it.
/OI/! Stealin' from the thieves? That's MY job!
Put it back, you /INSULT/, or I take your hands.
You got nerve. Not much sense, though.
That's ours! We stole it first!
Thief! Thief in the camp!
Stealing from slavers? That's a bad business, friend.
Put it back. Everything in here's already sold.
Thief! Shackles for him!
You take what isn't yours? Then you can be what isn't yours.
I trade in people, and even I think that's low.
Thief! You take pot meat! Put back!
Hands for eating, not stealing. Give back.
/CANNIBALHA/! Little thief steal from ungry.
My dhings. My teeth in your arm, soon.
Give back, give back, or we take odher way.
/OI/! Ya stealin' from a Hound? Yer mad.
Put it back or I'll chew yer hand off!
Thief in me place! Get 'im!
That's mine, ya mud-brained /BASTARD/.
Ya've got guts. They'll look nice on the floor.
Thief! Help! A thief among the faithful!
Okran sees you, thief! Put that back!
Guards! This one steals from believers!
That's all I have! Put it back!
Sinner! Thief! Somebody!
Hey! That's mine! Give it back!
Thief! Please, I have so little!
Put it down! Put it down, I'll scream!
Help! He's robbing me! Somebody!
I worked for that! Stop!
Intruder in the sacred halls! Seize the heretic!
You weren't invited, outlander. Okran punishes trespass.
How did you get past the door? Never mind.
A heretic among the holy things.
You don't belong here. You won't leave.
A /FLATSKIN/ in our house? You'll wish you had stayed outside.
Trespasser! Guards, here!
You walk in without a word. You'll leave without your legs.
There is a thief or a spy in the halls. Maybe both.
Out, or I carry you out in pieces.
Trespassing is a crime, stranger. Fines first, then the cell.
This building is private. Out, or I call the watch.
Who let you in? Stay exactly where you are.
Intruder! Check the locks, someone left it open.
I have a long memory for uninvited guests.
Someone in the barn! Get a fork!
You don't belong here. Out, or I make you go.
A spy for the nobles? Or only a fool?
Quiet, everyone. There's a stranger in the house.
Out. Now. Before the others hear.
You walked in without a sound. I walked in behind you. Don't turn.
Not a customer. Not one of ours. A slaver's spy?
No visitors. Out. Or in pieces.
I didn't hear you come in.
Whoever you are, you picked the wrong door.
Hold it right there. Nobody comes into my stock without asking.
A snoop in the workshop. Good way to lose a hand.
Intruder. Dangerous gear in here. Hands where I can see them.
How did you get in? Doesn't matter.
Salvage thieves get worse than nothing.
Intruder! Get the shackles! Get the guards!
A visitor with no appointment. That means fresh stock, or a thief.
You're inside the wrong door, friend.
Not a buyer. Not a seller. So what are you?
Stay put. We'll find a use for you.
Guest come in, no knock! Bery rude.
In kitchen! Meat walk in by self! /CANNIBALHA/!
You walk in? You no walk out. Not in one piece.
Snoop, snoop. Smell pot, you? Stay for it.
Who invite you? Nobody. Stay, dhen.
/OI/! Who let you in? Nobody. Right. Get 'im!
That's a Hound's place, ya fool.
Sneakin' in, are ya? Sneak back out in pieces.
Ya picked the wrong den, /BASTARD/.
What're ya lookin' for, hmm? A grave?
Intruder! Get up, get up, there's someone in!
How the /FUCKING/ hell did you get in here?
You're in the wrong place at the wrong time, /RUNT/.
Nobody walks into our camp. Nobody walks out, either.
Not one of ours. Kill him!
Who's there? Who's there?! Guards!
An intruder! In Okran's name, guards!
Help! There's someone in the house!
Heretic! In my home! Guards!
Get out! Get out! I'm calling the paladins!
Who are you? What do you want? Guards!
Get out of my house!
Help! Somebody is inside!
Take what you want, just don't hurt me!
Stay away from me! Guards!
Run, heretic. Okran's patience is longer than your legs. For now, I turn back.
Enough. Let the desert burn them for us.
They aren't worth another step. The Flame will find them anyway.
Back to the post. We'll meet again, heretic.
Fast legs. Fast legs run out, in the end.
Run, then, /FLATSKIN/. A Shek doesn't chase what's already beaten.
Let them go. Another day, another spear.
I'll find them again. Kral is patient.
Cowards run. Warriors remember.
Not worth the wind. Back to my post.
Forget it. Not enough cats in the bounty to go on.
They're gone. File it and move on.
Out of my district, then. Good riddance.
I don't get paid by the mile.
Let them run. The law has a long memory, even if I have short legs.
Let them go. We have crops to watch.
They aren't coming back. Probably.
I am a farmer, not a hunter. Back to the field.
Run, then. We know where you went.
Enough. We hold the land. We don't need to chase.
Gone. Another day, then.
Let them run. Everyone leaves a trail eventually.
No use. We have bigger work than this.
They slip away. I'll remember the face.
Back to the shadows. They think they won.
Not worth the gear. I'm turning around.
Fine, run. The wasteland will do the rest.
Chasing costs time, and time costs cats. Done.
Gone. I have salvage waiting anyway.
Enough. They're somebody else's problem now.
Ah, to hell with it. I ain't runnin' no more!
Run! Run, and don't come back, ya /INSULT/!
Me legs hurt, me belly hurts. Let 'em go.
They'll die out there anyway. Probably.
Not worth it. We got better things to rob.
Gone. A pity. Good stock, too.
Let them run. The desert collects its own debts.
Not worth the pursuit. There are other legs on the road.
They slipped us. Mark the face for next time.
Back to the post. Perhaps we find them later, in worse shape.
Meat run away. Meat fast today.
Ha. Let go. Let run. We find later.
Too ungry to chase. Too tired to eat.
Smell stay. We follow smell next time.
Run, run, little meat. Pot wait.
Ah, bugger it. Not runnin' any more.
Run, ya /BASTARD/! Don't come back!
They're quick. Fine. Let the swamp get 'em.
Not worth the mud. Back to the bar.
I'll remember that face. Next time.
Target lost. Pursuit discontinued.
Returning. They were faster than expected.
No further use in the chase.
They're out of range.
Pursuit abandoned. Resuming prior task.
A weapon for the faithful. The Flame has a use for it.
Heretics shouldn't hold blades. I'll carry it for them.
Confiscated in Okran's name.
Better in a paladin's hand than in the dust.
Weapons are a privilege. This one has been revoked.
A warrior takes what the beaten no longer need.
A decent blade, wasted on you.
I'll take this. You haven't earned the right to swing it.
Poor steel. I shall take it anyway.
Rest. The blade goes where it's respected.
Seized and logged. Don't look at me like that.
Weapons turn up in the strangest places. This one turned up in my hand.
It's a fine for disturbing the peace.
A good sword, ill used. Properly valued, it's worth a few cats.
I'm sure someone will claim it.
We need blades more than they do. Sorry.
A good edge. Going to a good cause.
The nobles have blades aplenty. We have a hoe.
I'll put it to better use than you did.
Nothing personal. We're outnumbered.
A slaver's blade is a lesser thing, but it still cuts chains.
It will do good work now.
Whatever you did with this, I'll do it better.
One less sword to threaten the weak.
Not a theft. A redistribution.
Decent steel. I can sell it or use it.
Salvage is salvage. Thank you for the donation.
Scrap value, at least. Maybe a bit more.
A tool left lying around. Hard to resist.
I always say, never walk past good steel.
Nice, nice. Gimme!
Ha! Ya won't be needin' this where yer goin'.
Mine now, ya /INSULT/.
Finders keepers. And I found it on yer hand.
That's a better sword than me own.
Stock arrives with its own equipment, sometimes.
Weapons are for the owners, not the merchandise.
I'll sell this. Maybe you with it.
A good blade. A shame about the previous owner.
Everything has a price. Even this.
Sharp dhing! Good for kitchen!
Meat no need teeth. We keep blade.
Ha! Shiny stick. Shiny stick ours.
Take, take. Meat no miss it.
Pretty knife. Pretty, pretty. Cut somedhing later.
That's a nice blade. Shame it's gonna be mine.
Ya won't be needin' that where yer lyin'.
Finders keepers in the swamp. Always has been.
Free sword! Ha!
Yer loss, me gain. That's the Hound way.
Weapon acquired. Efficiency improved.
Useful. I'll keep it.
Their weapon is no longer in use. It will be in mine.
Materials are scarce. This will do.
Equipment transfer completed.
Hm? Okran? Is it dawn? Mm.
Who prays? Who... no. Nothing. Sleep.
Paladin, is that you? ...Mm. Later.
Burn... burn them... no. Sleeping.
Kral? ...no. A dream. Sleep.
Who walks near? ...never mind. Sleep.
A hand on my spear. ...mine.
Not now, brother. The watch isn't mine.
Mm? Is it payday? ...no. Later.
Whose coin is that? ...ah. Mine. Sleep.
Five more minutes, boss. Five. Mm.
Contract is signed. Don't wake me. ...Mm.
Hm? The crops? The fire? ...no. Quiet. Sleep.
Who's there? ...nobody. Sleep.
Mm. Barn door. Again. Tomorrow.
Is that the lord's men? ...no. Dream.
Mm. Shadow. ...shadow. Go back to sleep.
Who's there... a dream. Another dream.
No chains. No chains. Mm.
Hush. Hush. They're asleep. Hush.
Mm? The ruin? ...no. Not yet.
Who touched the pack? ...ah. Nobody. Mm.
Scrap, scrap, more scrap. Zzzz.
Is that a signal? ...no. Old dream.
Wha...? Who's there? ...nobody. Back to sleep.
Stop takin' me food. ...huh. Dream. Mm.
Mm? Raid? ...no. Sleep.
Five more cats... just five more... hm.
Hm? Stock? ...no. Count in the morning.
Chains rattle. ...ah. Just the wind. Sleep.
Who is walking? ...never mind. Mm.
Sold. Sold. All of them sold.
Mm... ungry. So ungry. Supper? ...no. Sleep.
Who come? What smell? ...dream.
Mm. Pot empty. Dream full.
Bell? ...no bell. Sleep. Sleep.
Mmph? Wassat? ...nuthin'. Sleep.
Who's there? ...bugger off. Sleep.
Mud's cold. Mm. Cold, cold.
Big Grim...? ...no. Dream.
Back in the collar. Did you think the desert would feed you?
Home again. The price on your head was lower than you thought.
Running costs more than staying. You'll learn that.
Welcome back to the stock. You are a little thinner.
I let you run. I always find you. Remember that.
You ran from Okran, and Okran found you.
The Flame doesn't forget a runaway.
Mercy isn't a right. You'll serve until the light says otherwise.
Heretics always try the desert first. Then they come back.
You tasted the open road. Now taste the work.
Faster! The sun does not wait for lazy hands!
Heads down! Nobody rests until the count is right!
I paid for working arms, not resting ones. Move!
Less looking around, more carrying!
You eat when the work is done. Not before.
Work is penance. Don't slow in your repentance!
Faster! The Holy Nation doesn't feed idle hands!
Labour for Okran, or answer to the Flame!
Do not stare at me, slave.
Idle hands are heretic hands. Move!

dialogues.note: Was no_target_races, which neither Kenshi nor Meitou reads; now an explicit target_races list.

say: Welcome to your new home. It has a roof, mostly.
Get used to the weight of those. They aren't coming off.
Work, eat, sleep. That's all there's now.
Stand there and don't speak.
A new face for the line.
Here's your cell, heretic. Here's your work.
You are Okran's now. Be grateful it was a living thing that took you.
You'll be fed. You'll be watched.
Look at the ground. It is where you belong.
Another soul to be cleansed. Begin.
Runaway! Stop that one! Stop them!
Someone is loose! Shackles, now!
Don't let them reach the gate!
I smell money running away! Catch it!
Hey! Where do you think you're going?
A runaway! Seize the heretic!
Escape! In Okran's name, stop them!
The slave is loose! Sound the alarm!
You won't run far, sinner!
Heretic loose! Don't let them reach the gate!
That is the contract done. I would say it was a pleasure.
Time is up. I'm heading to the nearest bar.
Your cats are spent. Mine are earned. We are square.
Job is finished. Do not follow me.
I don't do loyalty. I do deadlines.
My word is kept. The contract is finished.
I leave with honour intact. I hope you do the same.
The service is complete. Don't mistake it for friendship.
Our bargain ends here, /FLATSKIN/. Walk well.
The Shek keep their word. I've kept mine.
That's it, mate. Contract's up. Don't take it personal.
Good while it lasted. Mostly. I'm off.
My part's done. I got cats, you got your life. Fair?
Right. Home. Sand. Away from you.
Time's over. If you want more, bring more cats.
